title: smtp: Config struct and smtp.toml format
description: Implement crates/smtp/src/config.rs. Config struct: listen: ListenConfig { port_25: String (default '0.0.0.0:25'), port_587: String (default '0.0.0.0:587') }; tls: TlsConfig { cert_path: Option<String>, key_path: Option<String> } (default: both None); limits: LimitsConfig { max_message_bytes: u64 (default 25*1024*1024 = 26214400), max_recipients: usize (default 100), command_timeout_secs: u64 (default 300) }; hostname: String (default 'localhost'); log: LogConfig (same as mail crate: level=info, format=json). Config::from_file, Config::validate (check non-empty ports, TLS both-or-neither). ConfigError enum (Io, Parse, Validation). Tests: parse minimal toml, validate TLS both-or-neither, defaults applied.
